checks.claim: Approval does not change source status
checks.evidence: Registry.lookup takes only (sha256, provision_id); no approval input. source_entries computes text_status separately from 'verified'.

warning_text returns None only for verified_current with trust_verified=True; every other status always yields a template. Tests: test_approval_never_removes_a_non_current_warning, test_rule81_style_warning_persists_after_simulated_approval, Stage 26 conflict and multi-chunk tests.

checks.claim: Registry hash change invalidates the signature binding
checks.evidence: source_status_sha256 is inside the signed bytes; evaluate() compares it with the file on disk; server fingerprint includes the registry. Tests: test_changed_registry_invalidates_a_correctly_signed_record, test_binding_cannot_be_edited_without_breaking_the_signature, test_server_binds_registry_and_goes_stale_when_it_changes.

checks.claim: Missing or malformed registry fails safely
checks.evidence: load() never raises; absent/invalid -> every chunk UNRECORDED (warns) and grounded gate blocks. Tests: test_load_fails_closed, test_missing_registry_fails_closed, test_invalid_registry_blocks_grounded_answers, test_pre_stage25_record_fails_closed.
parse requires a complete review block and decision reference; verified_current still warns unless a valid approval binds this exact registry.
checks.limitation: Code checks completeness, not that the reviewer is authorised; authorisation rests on the signed approval binding the registry.
